name: FarDriver Generic H/L/R/Q/I/J/X/U/M/N Settings
description: Manual-backed FarDriver setting catalog for richer-parameter controllers. Some settings below are now APK-confirmed from the official Xamarin app, but many are still register-based decodes rather than a clean Kelly-style linear flash map.

settings.label: Position Sensor
settings.description: Motor position sensor type / angle detect mode.

settings.label: Temperature Sensor
settings.description: Motor temperature sensor selection. Official app decodes this from register 6, data byte 10, bits 4-6.

settings.label: Phase Shift
settings.description: Motor phase offset / angle compensation. Official app decodes `(arg[3]*256 + arg[2]) / 10` from register 12.

settings.label: Morse Code
settings.description: Controller-identified motor code / tuned identifier from the official app register 6 decode.

settings.label: Pole Pairs
settings.description: Motor pole pair count. Official app reads this from register 18, data byte 4.

settings.label: Motor Direction
settings.description: Default rotation direction. Official app uses bit 7 of register 6 data byte 11.

settings.label: Rated Speed
settings.description: Rated motor speed. Official app decodes this from register 24.

settings.label: Rated Voltage
settings.description: Rated battery/motor voltage. Official app decodes `(arg[13]*256 + arg[12]) / 10` from register 18.

settings.label: Rated Power
settings.description: Rated output power. Official app reads this from register 18.

settings.label: Maximum Speed
settings.description: Absolute speed cap. Official app reads this from register 18.

settings.label: Maximum Phase Current
settings.description: Peak phase current limit. Official app decodes `(arg[9]*256 + arg[8]) / 4` from register 42.

settings.label: Maximum Line Current
settings.description: Peak battery/line current limit. Official app decodes `(arg[5]*256 + arg[4]) / 4` from register 24.

settings.label: Reverse Speed
settings.description: Reverse speed cap as a percentage of forward speed.

settings.label: Swap Phase Wires
settings.description: Phase exchange / swap phase wires option.

settings.label: Weak Magnetic Properties
settings.description: Weak-field or field-weakening characteristic parameter.

settings.label: Weak Magnetic Response
settings.description: Weak-field response or reaction gain.

settings.label: Acceleration Sensitivity
settings.description: Response sharpness during acceleration.

settings.label: Deceleration Sensitivity
settings.description: Response sharpness during deceleration.

settings.label: Motor Position
settings.description: Motor installation position.

settings.label: Throttle Return
settings.description: Throttle return characteristic or release behavior.

settings.label: Throttle Response
settings.description: Direct throttle response gain.

settings.label: Economic Acceleration Parameter
settings.description: Economy-mode acceleration shaping parameter.

settings.label: Low Threshold
settings.description: Low-end throttle calibration threshold. Official app decodes `arg[6] / 20` from register 6.

settings.label: High Threshold
settings.description: High-end throttle calibration threshold. Official app decodes `arg[7] / 20` from register 6.

settings.label: Production Date
settings.description: Controller date/time block.

settings.label: Duration
settings.description: Total duration / controller uptime style field mentioned in the manual.

settings.label: Controller Model
settings.description: Model identity field.

settings.label: Current Limit at 500 RPM
settings.description: Current limiting curve point.

settings.label: Current Limit at 1000 RPM
settings.description: Current limiting curve point.

settings.label: Current Limit at 2000 RPM
settings.description: Current limiting curve point.

settings.label: Current Limit at 3000 RPM
settings.description: Current limiting curve point.

settings.label: Current Limit at 4000 RPM
settings.description: Current limiting curve point.

settings.label: Current Limit at 5000 RPM
settings.description: Current limiting curve point.

settings.label: Current Limit at 7000 RPM
settings.description: Current limiting curve point.

settings.label: Current Limit at 9000 RPM
settings.description: Current limiting curve point.

settings.label: Speed Control Levels
settings.description: How many speed modes the controller exposes.

settings.label: Low Speed Ratio
settings.description: Low-speed mode ratio. Official app derives this from register 48 byte 4.

settings.label: Middle Speed Ratio
settings.description: Middle-speed mode ratio. Official app derives this from register 48 byte 5.

settings.label: Low Speed Weak Field
settings.description: Low-speed field weakening/current coefficient. Official app derives this from register 48 byte 6.

settings.label: Middle Speed Weak Field
settings.description: Middle-speed field weakening/current coefficient. Official app derives this from register 48 byte 7.

settings.label: LDVOL
settings.description: Low-voltage related threshold from the manual.

settings.label: LQVOL
settings.description: Secondary low-voltage threshold from the manual.

settings.label: FAIF
settings.description: Manual-listed threshold / factor, meaning still to be validated against live dumps.

settings.label: Speed Limit
settings.description: Speed limit in RPM.

settings.label: Brake Current
settings.description: Brake current setting.

settings.label: Maximum Brake Current
settings.description: Maximum regenerative or braking current.

settings.label: Throttle Return Brake Point
settings.description: Return-throttle brake trigger point.

settings.label: Brake Voltage
settings.description: Brake input voltage threshold or calibration.

settings.label: Negative Current Coefficient at 500 RPM
settings.description: Negative current / regen coefficient curve point.

settings.label: Negative Current Coefficient at 1000 RPM
settings.description: Negative current / regen coefficient curve point.

settings.label: Negative Current Coefficient at 2000 RPM
settings.description: Negative current / regen coefficient curve point.

settings.label: Negative Current Coefficient at 3000 RPM
settings.description: Negative current / regen coefficient curve point.

settings.label: Negative Current Coefficient at 5000 RPM
settings.description: Negative current / regen coefficient curve point.

settings.label: Negative Current Coefficient at 7000 RPM
settings.description: Negative current / regen coefficient curve point.

settings.label: Negative Current Coefficient at 9000 RPM
settings.description: Negative current / regen coefficient curve point.
